scope: Ten individually selected same-name CFS factual nutrient references. This is not a copy of the CFS workbook and does not validate all recipe formulas.

source.name: Hong Kong Centre for Food Safety, Food Research Laboratory (FRL)
source.license: No open licence asserted; CFS copyright notice applies

source_workbook.version_note: Workbook modification date, not food sampling date. English and simplified-Chinese sheets were cross-checked for these selected names.

definitions.quantity_basis: per 100 g cooked edible prepared food
definitions.carbohydrate: Available carbohydrate by difference (CHOAVLDF), not USDA total carbohydrate.
definitions.dietary_fibre: Total dietary fibre (FIBTG), AOAC 985.29. Trace is retained as a qualifier, not converted to zero.
definitions.energy: Published laboratory-based energy, calculated by CFS from protein, available carbohydrate, fat and alcohol with 4/4/9/7 factors. Rounded source energy is retained; fibre energy is not added.
definitions.missing_ranges: No sample count, collection date or range is asserted except the two explicitly linked 2017 study rows.
definitions.ranges: Observed sample minimum and maximum, not a confidence interval, prediction interval or universal bound.
definitions.compatible_preparations: Source-specific preparation enums derived only from explicit CFS food descriptions. as_served always means the source cooked edible prepared state, never raw. Where the source omits a cooking route, only as_served is supported; ingredient-recipe methods are not evidence for the measured reference.

rights.scope: Only ten selected factual nutrient entries and source attribution are included; the workbook is not republished. The CFS notice reserves rights in protected content and data compilations and refers to prior written FEHD authorisation. Permission for redistribution of a compilation was not verified; this file does not assert such permission or a legal conclusion about individual facts.

preservation.fingerprint_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True and separators=(comma,colon). Original ingredient records and complete recipe records without measured_reference are unchanged.

records.source_name_en: Braised bean curd and minced pork in chilli sauce
records.match_limit_zh: 同名麻婆豆腐；豆腐含水量、肉末肥瘦及辣酱比例会变化；不是本应用简化配方的实测值。
records.match_limit_en: Same named mapo tofu; tofu moisture, minced-pork fat and chilli sauce proportions vary. This is not a measurement of the app simplified recipe.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源英文名称明确为 Braised bean curd；因此支持红烧／焖烧，不从本应用配方推断其他做法。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source names braised bean curd, supporting braised. No additional route is inferred from the app recipe.

records.source_name_en: Sauteed pork slices with assorted vegetable in chilli sauce
records.match_limit_zh: 同名回锅肉；肉的部位、肥瘦、蔬菜及酱汁比例会变化。
records.match_limit_en: Same named twice-cooked pork; pork cut, fat content, vegetables and sauce proportions vary.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源英文名称明确为 Sauteed pork slices，对应炒；来源未说明前置煮制过程，因此不把水煮单独视为同一成品。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source names sauteed pork slices, supporting stir_fried. It does not document preliminary boiling, so boiled alone is not treated as the same prepared dish.

records.match_limit_zh: 同名虾仁炒蛋；鸡蛋与虾仁比例、油及酱汁会变化。所列范围仅为2017年10份餐饮样本的观测范围，不是置信区间。
records.match_limit_en: Same named scrambled egg with shrimp; egg-to-shrimp ratio, oil and sauces vary. The stated range is the observed range of ten restaurant samples from 2017, not a confidence interval.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源中文名称为虾仁炒蛋，对应炒；不适用于生食或蒸制版本。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source Chinese name specifies stir-fried shrimp and egg, supporting stir_fried. Raw or steamed versions are different preparations.

records.match_limit_zh: 同名蒜泥白肉；五花肉肥瘦、煮后脂肪流失及拌汁比例会变化。
records.match_limit_en: Same named sliced pork with garlic sauce; pork fat content, cooking losses and dressing proportions vary.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源名称仅描述蒜泥白肉／Sliced Pork with Garlic Sauce，未明确烹调路线；仅接受按来源成品状态，不推断水煮。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source names sliced pork with garlic sauce without specifying its cooking route. Only the source prepared state is supported; boiled is not inferred.

records.source_name_en: Steamed chicken in chilli oil sauce
records.match_limit_zh: 同名口水鸡；鸡皮、部位、辣油和配料比例会变化；称重须扣除骨头。
records.match_limit_en: Same named chicken in chilli oil sauce; skin, cuts, chilli oil and garnish proportions vary. Weighed grams must exclude bones.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源英文名称明确为 Steamed chicken in chilli oil sauce，支持蒸制；本应用原示例配方写水煮，不用于覆盖来源做法。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source explicitly names steamed chicken in chilli oil sauce, supporting steamed. The app illustrative boiled-chicken recipe does not override the source preparation.

records.match_limit_zh: 同名红烧豆腐；豆腐种类、含水量、油及酱汁比例会变化；来源未提供与本应用相同的配方。
records.match_limit_en: Same named braised tofu; tofu type, moisture, oil and sauce proportions vary. The source does not provide a formula identical to the app recipe.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源英文名称明确为 Braised tofu，对应红烧／焖烧；不推断煎炸等其他步骤。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source names braised tofu, supporting braised. Frying or other steps are not inferred.

records.source_name_en: Pork and pineapple with sweet and sour sauce
records.match_limit_zh: 同名菠萝咕噜肉；肉的肥瘦、裹粉、菠萝、糖醋汁及留油会变化。所列范围仅为2017年10份餐饮样本的观测范围，不是置信区间。
records.match_limit_en: Same named pork and pineapple with sweet and sour sauce; pork fat, batter, fruit, sauce and retained oil vary. The stated range is the observed range of ten restaurant samples from 2017, not a confidence interval.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源名称仅描述菠萝咕噜肉及甜酸汁，未明确裹粉、炸制或后续翻炒路线；仅接受按来源成品状态，不从本应用配方推断煎炸或炒。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source names pork and pineapple with sweet and sour sauce without specifying coating, frying or subsequent stir-frying. Only the source prepared state is supported; fried or stir_fried is not inferred from the app recipe.

records.source_name_en: Deep fried spare ribs with salt and pepper
records.match_limit_zh: 同名椒盐排骨；排骨肥瘦、裹粉及留油会变化；每100克指去骨可食部分。
records.match_limit_en: Same named deep-fried spare ribs with salt and pepper; meat fat, coating and retained oil vary. Per 100 g refers to the edible portion excluding bones.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源英文名称明确为 Deep fried spare ribs with salt and pepper，对应煎炸类别中的炸制；不支持蒸制排骨。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source explicitly names deep-fried spare ribs with salt and pepper, supporting the fried enum. Steamed ribs are a different preparation.

records.source_name_en: Fried flat noodles with sliced beef
records.match_limit_zh: 同名干炒牛河；河粉含水量、牛肉比例及油量会变化。
records.match_limit_en: Same named dry-fried flat rice noodles with beef; noodle moisture, beef proportion and oil vary.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源中文名称为干炒牛肉河粉，明确对应炒；英文 Fried 不解释为深炸。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source Chinese name explicitly specifies dry stir-fried flat noodles with beef, supporting stir_fried. The English word fried is not interpreted as deep-fried.

records.match_limit_zh: 同名鸡丝冷面／凉面；面条含水量、鸡肉、黄瓜及拌酱比例会变化；未核实该来源记录的样本数、采样年份或观测范围。
records.match_limit_en: Same named cold noodles with shredded chicken; noodle moisture, chicken, cucumber and dressing proportions vary. Sample count, collection year and observed range for this row have not been verified.
records.preparation_notes_zh: 来源名称仅描述鸡丝冷面／凉面，未明确鸡肉或面条的烹调路线；仅接受按来源冷面成品状态，不推断水煮或生食。
records.preparation_notes_en: The source names cold noodles with shredded chicken without specifying how the chicken or noodles were cooked. Only the source prepared cold-noodle state is supported; boiled or raw is not inferred.
